title: T1: one table for the admin's lists (the table standard)
why: Jason, 2026-11-19: "The table presentation needs a standard implementation plan", the plan approved with his change ("the table having pagination and count controls too"), design/table-standard.md (PR #1044). admin-kit.js's List, the 2026-11-12 list standard (sortable columns, Columns, Show 10/25/50/100 a page, Show more, the page bar with the count from the server), extended in place: a status column (a dot with its word), labeled times, a sub-line under the name, one visible action and a ⋯ menu with words (a greyed item says why), group rows that open to their members, a column with no data yet named under the table (never hidden), a skeleton while loading, sentence-case headers, numbers and dates right-aligned, any endpoint as a source. tv_table() (app/admin/kit-table.php) draws the section; tv_w_table() stays and calls it, so every manifest list moves onto it unchanged. Pulse (T2) and the Control Board's own table (its session) move next. Tests: tools/design-tests/table.mjs (21) and table.php (5). FAQ: how the admin's lists work.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
Put on staging (5 files); its checks passed.
